messages:
Cass (People Ops): Quick escalation: a partner audit moved our calibration sign-off earlier by 48h. We need expedited delegation and a short audit CSV of reviewers who finalized after delegation. Please post deputies or backups now.
Darren (ENG Manager): Ack. Two reviewers on my team are in different timezones and one is mid-travel. Can I delegate finalization to a senior IC for this cycle?
Cass (People Ops): Yes but please keep it limited: deputies with finalization rights must be manager-level or have explicit written delegation from the manager. If you delegate to an IC, add `delegation-note` in the review and cc people-ops. We'll include it in the CSV.
Sofia (HRBP): Also note: any finalization by a deputy that changes a rating by >1 band requires a calibration exception and HR must be notified. Deputies should add `cal-exception: yes` + short justification if that occurs.
Ravi (Recruiting): Heads-up: we can move candidate slots to free up reviewers between 13:00-16:00 PT tomorrow. DM me names + Lattice handles and I'll reshuffle.
Darren (ENG Manager): I'll nominate Mina (@mina-eng) as deputy with `finalize-if-absent` for Team Vega. Where do we paste the delegation comment?
Cass (People Ops): Paste this verbatim in the review comments so it's machine-extractable: ```Deputy: Mina (@mina-eng)\nScope: finalize-if-absent\nReason: travel with limited Lattice access\nDelegation-notes: finalize only if primary reviewer unavailable >12h``` We'll pull matching comments for the audit CSV.
oncall-bot: Reminder: "Expedited delegation list due" in 3 hours. :bell:
Darren (ENG Manager): Also, if a deputy finalizes, do we need to re-upload manager evidence? One reviewer may have left additional logs.
Cass (People Ops): If new evidence materially affects the rating, mark `reopen-request: yes` with 1-line rationale and we'll triage. Minor additions can be appended as `post-final-evidence`. For audit purposes, note `post-final-evidence` in the review comment.
Sofia (HRBP): Quick compliance reminder: redact customer PII before sharing evidence externally. Use the redaction checklist from the shared folder. If you need legal sign-off, ping legal.
Ravi (Recruiting): Sending proposed interview blocks now. If anyone needs candidate moves, reply with handles.
Darren (ENG Manager): Added deputy comment and flagged one late evidence upload. Mina will finalize only if needed.
Cass (People Ops): Thanks 44d We'll generate the CSV from `Deputy:` comments and `cal-exception` tags. If deputization changes after the bot reminder, DM me and cc people-ops@redwood.com.
